translationRepairs: In Tongzhi 7, on Zuo Zongtang's western campaign, he helped capture Huaiyuan and Zhenbian, pacified Suide on the return, and received the title Fafuling Baturn.
In Tongzhi 7, on Zuo Zongtang's western campaign, he helped capture Huaiyuan and Zhenbian, pacified Suide on the return, and received the title Fafuling Baturu.
巴圖魯 is the Manchu honorific Baturu ('hero'); 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
Seeing through the deception, Jintang concealed troops at Xiqiao and Yongning Cave, defeated Hualong again, pushed on to Xiajia Bridge, and took the East Gate.
Seeing through the deception, Jintang concealed troops at Xiaqiao and Yongning Cave, defeated Hualong again, pushed on down to Caijia Bridge, and took the East Gate.
下橋 was rendered 'Xiqiao', and 下蔡家橋 ('descended on Caijia Bridge') was garbled as 'Xiajia Bridge'.

Camping at Pingyi Post in Nianbo, he broke Xiaoxia Pass first, sent troops to take the hills north and south, lifted the siege, and Intendant Guo Xiangzhi came out with twenty thousand men, women, and children to greet him.

Camping at Pingrong Post in Nianbo, he broke Xiaoxia Pass first, sent troops to take the hills north and south, lifted the siege, and Intendant Guo Xiangzhi came out with twenty thousand men, women, and children to greet him.
平戎驛 is Pingrong Post; 'Pingyi' misreads 戎.
The next year he took Hezhou, captured Shan Dianchén, and put him to death.
The next year he took Hezhou, captured Shan Dianchen, and put him to death.
閃殿臣 romanizes as Shan Dianchen; the stray accent in 'Dianchén' is a typographic error.
That year he was appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and then transferred to Censor-in-Chief of the Office of Transmission.
That year he was appointed Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and then transferred to Commissioner of the Office of Transmission.
太常寺卿 is the chief minister of the court, not a vice minister, and 通政使 is the Commissioner of Transmission, not a censor-in-chief.
The court praised his service and granted the title Huoqin Baturn.
The court praised his service and granted the title Huoqin Baturu.
巴圖魯 is the Manchu honorific Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
Zongyu fled northwest to Zhenping; Yao pursued and killed him at Heilongji.
Zongyu fled northwest to Zhenping; Yao pursued and slaughtered his men at Heilongji.
追殺黑龍集 means pursuing and killing (the Nian) at Heilongji; Zhang Zongyu was not killed here, he drowned himself later (s0173).
As a youth he lived on Mount Wei and befriended Luo Zemin, encouraging each other in study.
As a youth he lived on Mount Wei and befriended Luo Zenan, encouraging each other in study.
羅澤南 is Luo Zenan; 'Luo Zemin' misreads 南 as 民.
When the Taiping rebels rose he gathered militia to defend his township and was recorded as instructor.
When the Zhai sect bandits rose he gathered militia to defend his township and was recorded as instructor.
齋匪 are the vegetarian-sect (Zhai) bandits, not the Taiping rebels.
For accumulated merit he rose to prefect of Zhili Prefecture.
For accumulated merit he rose to magistrate of an independent department.
直隸州知州 is the magistrate of an independent (directly administered) department, not a 'prefect of Zhili Prefecture'.
When Jiang and Anhui were pacified he received the title A'ergang Baturn.
When Jiang and Anhui were pacified he received the title A'ergang Baturu.
巴圖魯 is the Manchu honorific Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
Finding Guanzhong thinly defended, Dian moved Brigade General Zhou Dawu to hold Long and Qian and guard the rear.
Finding Guanzhong thinly defended, Dian moved Provincial Military Commander Zhou Dawu to hold Long and Qian and guard the rear.
提督 is a provincial military commander, not a brigade general (總兵).
Tan Zhonglin, supervising western expedition supplies, argued strongly that managing the Hunan Army rear was uniquely Dian's role.
Tan Zhonglin, supervising western expedition supplies, argued strongly that managing the rear of Zuo's army was uniquely Dian's role.
左軍 is Zuo Zongtang's army, not the 'Hunan Army'.
Later he followed Duolong'a to aid Hubei, recovered Huangmei, and received the title Tu'ergeqi Baturn.
Later he followed Duolong'a to aid Hubei, recovered Huangmei, and received the title Tu'ergeqi Baturu.
巴圖魯 is the Manchu honorific Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
Jin Shun was lenient; officers deceived him; Governor Tan Zhonglin impeached his indulgence until resentment boiled and proposed replacing the pay officer.
Jin Shun was lenient; officers deceived him; Governor-General Tan Zhonglin impeached his indulgence until resentment boiled and proposed replacing the pay officer.
總督 is a governor-general, not a governor.
Soon relief rebels arrived and fortified Pingyi Post.
Soon relief rebels arrived and fortified Pingrong Post.
平戎驛 is Pingrong Post; 'Pingyi' misreads 戎.
Jintang urgently attacked Gaozhai; heavy guns on the north hill under Zeng's sighting fired more than sixty shells and cracked the walls; he received the title Yibode'en Baturn.
Jintang urgently attacked Gaozhai; heavy guns on the north hill under Zeng's sighting fired more than sixty shells and cracked the walls; he received the title Yibode'en Baturu.
巴圖魯 is the Manchu honorific Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
South, north, and west Sichuan, Datong, Nianbo, and Dangar all rebelled; hearing alarm Zeng galloped back to defend the city.
The southern, northern and western valleys of Xining, Datong, Nianbo, and Dangar all rebelled; hearing alarm Zeng galloped back to defend the city.
南北西川 are the river valleys (川) around Xining, not 'Sichuan'.
He first campaigned against Taiping and Nian rebels and received the title Chuoleguolan Kuo Baturn.
He first campaigned against Taiping and Nian rebels and received the title Chuoleguolankuo Baturu.
綽勒郭蘭闊巴圖魯 is one honorific, Chuoleguolankuo Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
Remembering former merit, he was promoted deputy lieutenant general and granted the title Zhiyong Baturn.
Remembering former merit, he was promoted deputy lieutenant general and granted the title Zhiyong Baturu.
巴圖魯 is the Manchu honorific Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
Aiding Anhui he captured cities and passes and received the title Xilin Baturn.
Aiding Anhui he captured cities and passes and received the title Xilin Baturu.
巴圖魯 is the Manchu honorific Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
In Tongzhi 1 he followed Duolong'a into Shaanxi; at Dengzhou he defeated Guangdong bandit Chen Deicai at Zijing Pass and was promoted Xi'an Right Wing deputy lieutenant general.
In Tongzhi 1 he followed Duolong'a into Shaanxi; at Dengzhou he defeated Guangdong bandit Chen Decai at Zijing Pass and was promoted Xi'an Right Wing deputy lieutenant general.
陳得才 is Chen Decai; 'Deicai' is a misspelling (the sentence was also truncated).
Brigade General Huang Jinshan fought at Didao Kangjiayan, was routed, entered Gaolan, and raided in all directions.
Provincial Military Commander Huang Jinshan fought at Didao Kangjiayan, was routed, entered Gaolan, and raided in all directions.
提督 is a provincial military commander, not a brigade general.
He first followed Duxing'a against Guangdong bandits, rose to company commander, and received the title Mangzai Baturn.
He first followed Duxing'a against Guangdong bandits, rose to company commander, and received the title Manglai Baturu.
莽賚巴圖魯 is Manglai Baturu; 'Mangzai' misreads 賚 and 'Baturn' misspells Baturu.
At Qingshui Fort he received the title Fafu Ling'a Baturn.
At Qingshui Fort he received the title Fafuling'a Baturu.
法福靈阿巴圖魯 is the single honorific Fafuling'a Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
Made brigade general, he repeatedly fought Tuoming, Maming, and Bai Yanhu and won wherever he went.
He made him a subordinate general; thereafter Xu repeatedly fought Tuoming, Ma Ming, and Bai Yanhu and won wherever he went.
令充裨將 makes Xu Xuegong a subordinate general, not Wenlin a 'brigade general'; 馬明 is Ma Ming, not 'Maming'.
Storming Suzhou he pressed the city half a year; pursuing Landequan he was heavily wounded.
Storming Suzhou he pressed the city half a year; pursuing Lan Dequan he was heavily wounded.
藍得全 is a personal name, Lan Dequan, not a single word 'Landequan'.

Muslims harassed Anxi; he designed defense, killed many, wiped out west mountain fugitives, lifted Dunhuang's siege, rose to first rank, received the title Jianyong Baturn, and became Gucheng assistant commandant.

Muslims harassed Anxi; he designed defense, killed many, wiped out west mountain fugitives, lifted Dunhuang's siege, rose to first rank, received the title Jianyong Baturu, and became Gucheng assistant commandant.
巴圖魯 is the Manchu honorific Baturu; 'Baturn' is a misspelling.
Zhong's son Rendé inherited the false post and clashed with Tuoming, who attacked him with his faction.
Zhong's son Rende inherited the false post and clashed with Tuoming, who attacked him with his faction.
人得 romanizes as Rende; the accent in 'Rendé' is a typographic error.
